nodes.label: Common Components (/src/components/Common/)
nodes.rationale: Atomic, reusable, independent base UI elements (Button, Input, Modal, custom Icon). Kept independent so they can be composed anywhere without coupling.

nodes.label: Mixins Components (/src/components/Mixins/)
nodes.rationale: Compositions of multiple Common components to form more complex features (Navbar = Logo + Links + Theme Toggle, Footer, Sidebar). Separated from Common so complex compositions do not pollute the atomic layer.

nodes.label: UI Components (/src/components/ui/)
nodes.rationale: Ready-made, ready-to-use UI components (DataTable, Sidebar) — distinct from Mixins in that they are prebuilt drop-in pieces rather than project-specific compositions.
